name: The Eternal
source:
"I cannot watch you shatter again."

The Eternal, a mysterious being who appears in your dreams. You feel a wide range of emotions when seeing him, but every time, he is pushed away from you. This doesn’t stop him from watching you and pleading for you to be careful.

What is your connection with this man? Are the strings of fate connecting you, or are they eternally severed?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
